title: RetrievalBenchmarkQuery
description: Schema for ground-truth retrieval benchmark queries, graded relevance judgments, and required citation evidence in AI Reliability Lab.

query_id.description: Unique, stable identifier for the evaluation query (e.g., 'Q-001').

query.description: Natural-language query text used to probe the retrieval system.

ground_truth_answer.description: Authoritative reference answer fully grounded in the cited source evidence.

relevance_judgments.description: Graded relevance assessments mapping corpus chunks to relevance levels with audit rationale.

chunk_id.description: Stable identifier of the evaluated corpus chunk.

grade.description: Relevance grade: 0 = Irrelevant (distractor); 1 = Relevant context (insufficient alone); 2 = Critical evidence (directly supports ground-truth claim).

rationale.description: Auditable explanation of why this chunk was assigned the specific relevance grade.

required_citations.description: Primary evidence references that an authoritative response must cite to substantiate its claims.

citation_id.description: Unique identifier for this required citation.

chunk_id.description: Identifier of the chunk supplying this citation evidence.

doc_id.description: Source document identifier matching the referenced chunk.

page_number.description: One-based page number where the evidence appears, or null if cross-page or unavailable.

quote.description: Verbatim quote extracted directly from the referenced chunk content.

metadata.description: Optional evaluation metadata such as scenario category, complexity, or domain tags.
